preconditions.description: The input is a non-empty string.
The string consists only of Latin letters and digits.
The length of the string does not exceed 5*10^6.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == str(sum(degree(s[:i+1]) for i in range(len(s))))
postconditions.description: The output is the sum of the palindrome degrees of all prefixes of the input string, where degree(s) is the maximum k such that s is a k-palindrome (s is a palindrome and its prefix/suffix of length floor(len(s)/2) are (k-1)-palindromes), and s is 0-palindrome by definition.
